Lina M (CS): kickoff - Caldera private/VPC onboard. quick summary: customers see no outbound to our collectors, their KMS key hasn't allowed our role, and Splunk shows no audit events. compliance review next Tue, so timing matters. who owns what?
Ravi S (Net): i'll own egress. looks like their private subnets have 0.0.0.0/0 -> tgw but no NAT in the app AZ. can they add a route to nat-0abc for 10.30.0.0/16? pinging caldera-pm for CIDR confirm.
caldera-pm: confirming app CIDR 10.30.0.0/16 across us-west-2a/b. we'll add the NAT route if you give the exact route param.
Ravi S (Net): route to add: Destination 0.0.0.0/0 Target nat-0abc1234. i'll queue a small infra change. ETA 25m.
Bea C (Sec): KMS: their key policy only lists account admins. they should add our cross-account role arn: arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/redwood-service. sample policy line to attach to the key policy:
```
{"Sid":"AllowRedwood","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"*"}
```
Bea C (Sec): once they add it, we need a test decrypt call to confirm.
Omar T (Ops): i'll watch the forwarder and prepare to reload when egress is healthy. if logs still don't flow, i'll run a live tail and report errors.
deploy-bot: change scheduled 6843211250: apply-route-change caldera-app-rt (requires approval).
Lina M (CS): caldera, please confirm when NAT route is added and when KMS policy is updated so we can document any gaps to compliance.
caldera-pm: NAT route applied at 6843211260. KMS policy updated and role added at 6843211275. sent new Splunk HEC token via vault.
Omar T (Ops): reloaded forwarder with new token - initial error was 401 HEC unauthorized. after reload, events began at 6843211286. small ingestion gap ~1.5m.
Bea C (Sec): ran quick KMS decrypt test - success. KMS signoff complete.
Ravi S (Net): verified outbound to collector IPs from an instance in 10.30.0.0/16 - TCP 443 OK.
Lina M (CS): action items: Ops to capture the 1.5m gap in the compliance note and offer a targeted replay; Sec to keep KMS policy sample in runbook; Net to add NAT checklist to onboarding; CS to mark renewal risk as "monitoring" until audit completes. scheduling a 20m retro tomorrow. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
